title: Personen, Institutionen, Netzwerke
summary: Sparked by current studies on sexualised violence in educational contexts, a local working group at the Department of General and Historical Educational Science investigated whether the Pädagogisches Seminar Göttingen played a role in those contexts, and if so, in what way. Personal and institutional networks surrounding educational science in Göttingen from the 1960s to the present are being analysed.
